definitions.full: H2669. chophshuth or chophshith חפשׁות חָפְשִׁית, noun feminine freedom, separateness , only הַחָפְשִׁית בֵּית 2Kin 15:5 2Chr 26:21 Qr (Kt החפשׁות ) i.e. (si vera 1.) a separate house — a house apart (on account of his disease). חֵץ see below חצץ .
